*   $t$ as the independent variable

$$ r = \frac{1}{u} $$

$$ \dot{u} = \frac{du}{d\theta} \cdot \frac{d\theta}{dt} = u' \dot{\theta} $$
where $u' = \frac{du}{d\theta}$.
